Display the path of the configuration file.

Prints the file that slipway reads, or would read if it existed: --config, then SLIPWAY_CONFIG, then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/slipway/config.yaml. When the file does not exist, a note on stderr says so.

Examples:
  # Print the path of the configuration file
  slipway config path

Usage:
  slipway config path [flags]

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
